linkedin.title: This Week in Finance & Tech
linkedin.body:
Nvidia is facing a major internal crisis this week. The company’s board of directors has hired a leading US law firm to launch a thorough and independent investigation into CEO Jensen Huang. This follows reports of an affair between Huang and Alice Huang, an AI executive alleged to be an agent of the Chinese government. Jensen Huang has publicly acknowledged the affair, apologized for being unfaithful, and stated he is cooperating with the investigation. President Trump confirmed he has spoken with Huang about the matter and noted that the FBI is also looking into the allegations involving the suspected spy.

In other security news, France has officially blamed Iran for a series of cyberattacks targeting critical infrastructure. The attacks specifically targeted industrial refrigeration units in grocery stores and blood banks across France and parts of Europe. This marks a significant escalation in tensions and highlights the ongoing vulnerability of industrial supply chains to state-sponsored digital threats.

Staying informed on complex stories like these requires looking past the headlines to see the full picture. You can keep up with the latest developments at HEADLINNE.com.
